faq_heading: Homes near Hazelgrove Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Hazelgrove Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Hazelgrove Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: By name: a listing shows up when its description mentions Hazelgrove Elementary. Ask Jared to watch for nearby homes that leave the school out.

faq.q: How much do homes near Hazelgrove Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 189 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,312,500, townhomes $742,500, condos $479,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Hazelgrove Elementary?
faq.a: For the 189 homes that sold within 1 km of Hazelgrove Elementary, the median time on the market was 22 days and the median sale was 97.5% of list; 7% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Hazelgrove Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Clayton Heights Secondary (0.6 km west), Katzie Elementary (0.7 km east) and Regent Road Elementary (1.1 km north-west).

Hazelgrove Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 7057 - 191 Street. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Hazelgrove Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Hazelgrove Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Hazelgrove Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Hazelgrove Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 189 homes sold within 1 km of Hazelgrove Elementary: 62 houses, 108 townhomes and 18 condos. The largest group was townhomes, at a median of $742,500.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Hazelgrove Elementary

18 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Hazelgrove Elementary in a straight line (11 elementary, 4 secondary, 2 other, 1 middle; 2 independent). The closest is Clayton Heights Secondary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Martha Currie Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Katzie Elementary (0.7 km); the nearest independent school is Crescent Heights Academy (1.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Ecole Salish Secondary (1.4 km). Other elementary schools close by: Katzie Elementary (0.7 km east), Regent Road Elementary (1.1 km north-west), Maddaugh Elementary (1.3 km north-east), Hillcrest Elementary (1.5 km south-west), Adams Road Elementary (1.8 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Katzie Elementary, 0.7 km east of Hazelgrove Elementary.
